title: Null transport under temporal coarse-graining: lumpability and surrogate inference for threshold-derived time series - reproducibility package
description: Version 2.0.0 reproducibility package supporting the manuscript 'Null transport under temporal coarse-graining: lumpability and surrogate inference for threshold-derived time series'. This release adds the null-transport and lumpability formalism, Gaussian and operator-ablation diagnostics, within-fiber tests of lumpability, and a prospectively frozen application to 31 Chilean PM2.5 monitoring stations from SINCA. It includes the frozen SINCA cohort and inferential protocol, the analysis-ready 2018-2025 PM2.5 extract, station-level outputs, probability-equalization and missingness sensitivities, manuscript sources, figures, and executable analysis scripts. The original confirmatory synthetic evidence is retained. The former Amazon-CMIP6 illustration is no longer part of the manuscript.
